case.summary: Case CASE-004 (Card SC-03004-K943): The case was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.8 on transaction 4012152 ($96.55, domestic) [EV-43d5877e]. The card SC-03004-K943 had one prior transaction averaging $85.56 [EV-5657c47a] and two online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-3e9fd901]. A prior confirmed fraud case CC-4314 was linked to this customer/card [EV-6060809c], and the device profile used appears in another confirmed fraud case [EV-288f948b]. Six prior closed cases with the same card-not-present pattern were retrieved [EV-0bd118e6]. The customer denied making the purchases and confirmed possession of the physical card [EV-ea876538]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict, pattern card_not_present_fraud, probability 0.815, and exposure $182.11 across two transactions.
